package fixture

import (
	"errors"
	"os/exec"
)

// os/exec for its types only: no child is started here
func exitCode(c interface{ Run() error }) int {
	var e *exec.ExitError
	if errors.As(c.Run(), &e) {
		return e.ExitCode()
	}
	return 0
}

func describe(c *exec.Cmd) string { return c.String() }
